_comment: Extra read-only mirrors of the same tree. Everything here is added to art.json / mirrors.json and to the site's speed test automatically — so pointing a new CDN at the bucket is one entry, not a code change. These are origins we do NOT deploy to; the r2 origin and the Pages origin are handled by the sync itself.

_example.note: AWS CloudFront in front of the R2 bucket

extraOrigins.note: 创空间容器里的分流边缘层：本站不持任何字节，/assets/** 与 /fonts/** 由容器 302 出去，其余路径（页面/data/js/ws/healthz）由容器里的游戏服务器回答。**已上线**（2026-10-11 晚验收）：分流判定在游戏进程内（server/http/asset-jump.js），与容器侧 sidecar 共用同一份 sources.json 与纯函数——nginx 形态在创空间用不上（平台不执行我们的 CMD），进程内 302 覆盖同一职责。镜像通道：默认→R2 规范门牌（weishucdn）、?sp_source=openi→OpenI（仅作不需 CORS 的通道）。**2026-10-18 起不再有默认的 ms-dataset 通道**——该数据集已转私有，匿名 403，保留只会让边缘 302 到必然失败的源。probe 必须点名真实素材路径——默认的 /robots.txt 会落到游戏服务器上，量到的是游戏页面而不是镜像。
自建 ModelScope 数据集镜像。**2026-10-22 起重新启用并排第一**：数据集虽私有，但容器侧用 MODELSCOPE_API_TOKEN 换会话后可读（实测 resolve 302 → cdn-lfs 200）。它是 rank 的第一位，也是 sources.json 的首跳。

_git_comment: Origins that mount files out of THIS git repository through a public mirror chain. The interface files live on `main`; the 14,741-file / 2.14 GiB art tree (incl. 2,476 skins) lives on the orphan branch `assets-raw`, committed 2026-10-09 specifically so git-mount CDNs can serve it. Coverage is therefore FULL for every entry here: git-mount sources were only ever 'partial' because the asset tree had not been committed, not because the mirrors could not carry it. Each entry still carries its own probe path. Skins are served from this git-mount layer (assets-raw); R2/Pages also carries them now because the upstream release zip bundles assets/skins/** (verified byte-identical on weishucdn vs assets-raw). Statically is not listed: it truncated a 262,144-byte probe to 16,384 / 32,768 / 0 bytes across three attempts and 403'd 5/5 on a real 854 KB asset.

gitOrigins.note: jsDelivr 挂载本仓 git 内容（接口文件在 main，素材树在 assets-raw）
ghfast 镜像链挂载 raw.githubusercontent（国内可用）
jsDelivr 挂载素材树（assets-raw 分支）：MIME/ACAO/Range 206 已实测
ghfast 挂载素材树（assets-raw 分支）：MIME/ACAO/Range 206 已实测

OpenI（启智）raw 挂载：本仓素材树由 openi-mirror.yml 每天四次推送（远端已追平 19506266 / 14,741 文件 / 2.14 GiB，字节逐字节一致）。它把 Access-Control-Allow-Origin 写死成第三方域 experience.pro.iflyaicloud.com、不反射请求方、且二进制（png/skel）忽略 Range（文本才回 206），所以裸 URL 不能当浏览器运行时源（enabled:false）。但它已通过自有 Worker gitcdn-own（sp-git-mount-relay）**服务端回源 + 重写 ACAO:* + Range** 接进运行时：gitcdn-own 的素材后端第一优先就是 openi，失败回退 jsdelivr/ghfast。玩家走 gitcdn.jiangjiangze.icu 即可享受 OpenI 速度且不受其 CORS 限制。

_retired_comment: Retired origin ids. carryForwardOrigins restores any previously-published origin the current run does not produce, which is what keeps the Pages origin alive on runs without --pages -- but it also resurrects an origin that was deliberately removed from this file. Naming it here is how a removal sticks. r2-alt（weishucdn2）2026-10-20 已删掉 R2 自定义域：域名还在，但只返回 Cloudflare 的占位响应（639 B 外壳，/cdn/v1/index.json 与不存在的路径都返 200），不能当源用。
_disabled_comment: Origin ids that stay PUBLISHED but must not be selected. `retired` removes an origin from the interface; `disabled` keeps it visible so the site can show it and say why, while marking `enabled:false` for every selector to honour. Listed here as well as on the entry itself, because the two branches of this repo read it differently: the multi-source branch reads this list, main reads the entry's own `enabled`. Writing both is what makes the parking stick regardless of which one publishes next. The two jsdelivr entries were parked on that branch after measurement (slowest of the git mounts, and it times out on real assets — see docs/audit/asset-slowness-root-cause.md); they are repeated here so a main-branch publish cannot quietly re-enable them.
_order_comment: 发布顺序（2026-10-22 用户指令：**数据集第一位**，其次其他镜像源，最后 r2）。rank.json 的排序主键就是这个 order，所以数据集会排 #1。 **2026-10-24 用户指令：R2 不再作访问源、其域名已解绑 ⇒ speedcdn/r2 移出 order 并记 retired；R2 仅保留为上传中转（cdn/incoming 暂存 + promote）。**
